3:129.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

3:130.text: O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allāh that you may be successful.

3:131.text: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers.

3:132.text: And obey Allāh and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.
